## MLBB Boost FAQ: Pricing, Timing & Account Risks | MLBB Boost

Source: https://boostmlbb.ru/en/faq.html

FAQ

# Mobile Legends boost questions

Answers to the most common questions about our service

Didn't find an answer? Message us on Telegram[](https://t.me/Cla1ve)

### How long does the boost take?

Timing depends on the route, boost type, player availability and account requirements. The calculator estimate is preliminary. Confirm the start time and expected timing with support before paying.

### Who carries out the boost?

The player is assigned for your route and format. Before paying, ask about their game experience and confirm terms with support.

### Can I follow the process?

Yes, you can watch the process through the stream option in MLBB by logging in beforehand on your second account.

### Is email access required?

Under the service rules, account boosting does not require email access. Sharing game account access still carries risks. With party play you play yourself without sharing access with the assigned player.

### How are orders placed and paid for?

Orders are arranged through Telegram. First confirm the route, player, price and timing, then read the offer and payment terms. Confirm full or partial prepayment terms before transferring funds.

### Can the booster be replaced?

Contact support if you have concerns about your order. Player replacement and next steps are handled under the service terms.

### Can I get banned for boosting?

Account sharing and game services may conflict with the game’s rules. Absence of sanctions is not guaranteed. Read the disclaimer and security terms before ordering.

### Still have questions?

We're ready to answer any question you have on Telegram. Don't hesitate to reach out!

## Still have questions?

Message us on Telegram to discuss your question

## MLBB Mythic Placement — Rates & Orders | MLBB Boost

Source: https://boostmlbb.ru/en/guides/mythic-placement.html

[Home](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/) / [Services](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/services.html)

# Mythic placement in Mobile Legends

Choose a boost format and enter how many placement matches you have already played. The calculator will show your order estimate.

## Placement rates

Rates are quoted per win. Account, party, role and hero boosting have different rates. Compare them on the [prices page](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/prices.html) or check your estimate in the [calculator](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html).

## What to enter

-   Your current rank and star count.
-   Whether placement is complete; if not, matches played and wins.
-   Your target rank and preferred boost format.

## If you only want to enter Mythic

From Legend, you can select Mythic with zero stars. Extra placement wins are not needed for that target. If you want to progress further, select your target star count.

## Place your order

Check the estimate, then open the Telegram bot and confirm the start time. If you are unsure which fields to select, support can help with your order.

## MLBB Party Play vs Account Boosting | MLBB Boost

Source: https://boostmlbb.ru/en/guides/party-boost.html

[Home](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/) / [Services](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/services.html)

# Party play or account boosting: choose your format

With account boosting, the assigned player plays on your account. With party play, you play alongside them on your own account.

## Account boosting

Choose this format if you want the assigned player to handle your rank progression. Confirm your target, login method and start time. Game account access is needed; email access is not required.

## Playing together in a party

You retain control of your account and join the matches. Agree on a convenient time, region and roles. Party play has its own rates.

## Preferred role or hero

You can select the assigned player's role or the hero used for the route. Hero boosting is priced per star. MMR changes depend on matches and game rules; a leaderboard position is not guaranteed.

## Choosing your format

Choose party play if you want to play together, or account boosting if you prefer the assigned player to handle gameplay. Compare the price for the same ranks in the calculator, then arrange your order through the Telegram bot.

Before sharing account access, read the [security guidance](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/security.html) and [refund policy](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/refund.html).
